entries.label: restaurant01_explanatory_00
entries.text: The spicy sauce serves as a nice contrast to the sweetness\nof the vegetables in this sandwich.

entries.label: restaurant01_explanatory_01
entries.text: A sandwich made with only jam and slices of strawberry.\nThe simplicity of this dish is what makes it so appetizing.

entries.label: restaurant01_explanatory_02
entries.text: The balance of acidity and umami is key. A touch of extra\nmarmalade is the trick to making it special.

entries.label: restaurant01_explanatory_03
entries.text: A simple, economical, and tasty sandwich. Toasting it for\nextra flavor is also good.

entries.label: restaurant01_explanatory_04
entries.text: The flavor of this sandwich changes depending on the\nripeness of the avocado. One never tires of eating this.

entries.label: restaurant02_explanatory_00
entries.text: The various ingredients form a harmony of flavors.\nThis dish truly deserves to bear the name of the region.

entries.label: restaurant02_explanatory_01
entries.text: A variety of fruits weave a deep, rich flavor not found in\nany other juice.

entries.label: restaurant02_explanatory_02
entries.text: The roasted vegetables have a pronounced umami flavor.\nThey are great as a side dish—or even as hors d’oeuvres.

entries.label: restaurant02_explanatory_03
entries.text: Its unpretentious taste is soothing to the heart and palate.\nOne can’t go wrong with this classic Paldean tapa.

entries.label: restaurant02_explanatory_04
entries.text: A dish for enjoying rare ingredients in a simple way.\nThe leftover oil is good on pasta, too.

entries.label: restaurant03_explanatory_00
entries.text: The seafood is so fresh you can almost hear the ocean.\nIt is served up in a beautiful arrangement as well.

entries.label: restaurant03_explanatory_01
entries.text: The simple, gentle sweetness of this dish is comforting.\nIt’s good served chilled or warm.

entries.label: restaurant03_explanatory_02
entries.text: The acidity of this dish serves to whet one’s appetite.\nIts exceedingly fresh ingredients also add to the flavor.

entries.label: restaurant03_explanatory_03
entries.text: This dish blends the scents of both smoke and herbs.\nIt’s almost as if you are eating the aroma itself.

entries.label: restaurant03_explanatory_04
entries.text: The toppings change with the market’s catch of the day.\nIn a sense, the sea decides what this pasta will taste like.

entries.label: restaurant04_explanatory_00
entries.text: Four pieces of nigiri sushi inspired by beautiful flowers.\nThey’re all quite spicy for some reason.

entries.label: restaurant04_explanatory_01
entries.text: Four pieces of nigiri sushi inspired by playful birds.\nThey’re all quite sweet for some reason.

entries.label: restaurant04_explanatory_02
entries.text: Four pieces of nigiri sushi inspired by the blowing wind.\nThey’re all quite tart for some reason.

entries.label: restaurant04_explanatory_03
entries.text: Four pieces of nigiri sushi inspired by the radiant moon.\nThey’re all quite bitter for some reason.

entries.label: restaurant04_explanatory_04
entries.text: This bowl of soup uses well-aged miso. Even the stock\nis something special.

entries.label: restaurant05_explanatory_00
entries.text: Four pieces of nigiri sushi inspired by crisp frost. This\nstore-exclusive set was carefully selected by the chef.

entries.label: restaurant05_explanatory_01
entries.text: Four pieces of nigiri sushi inspired by soft graupel. This\nstore-exclusive set was made with all the skills of the chef.

entries.label: restaurant05_explanatory_02
entries.text: Four pieces of nigiri sushi inspired by stinging hail. This\nstore-exclusive set is highly recommended by the chef.

entries.label: restaurant05_explanatory_03
entries.text: Four pieces of nigiri sushi inspired by thick sleet. This\nstore-exclusive set was made with all the chef’s might.

entries.label: restaurant05_explanatory_04
entries.text: The clear broth is chock-full of umami. This store-\nexclusive dish is a work of passion.

entries.label: restaurant06_explanatory_00
entries.text: Though affordable, this dish is the real deal. The spicy,\ntingly taste is as authentic as can be.

entries.label: restaurant06_explanatory_01
entries.text: The elegant, refreshing sweetness is gentle on the tongue.\nThis dessert is a staple at many tables.

entries.label: restaurant06_explanatory_02
entries.text: This dish is perfect as a palate cleanser. The unobtrusive\nacidity is very comforting.

entries.label: restaurant06_explanatory_03
entries.text: The heavy seasoning of this dish makes it perfect as a\nside dish or a snack. It is a very popular menu item.

entries.label: restaurant06_explanatory_04
entries.text: The owner says he recreated this soy sauce-based ramen\nfrom a dish he had while traveling the Kanto region.

entries.label: restaurant07_explanatory_00
entries.text: This galette is made from the finest ingredients, refining\nthe dish to its highest possible quality.

entries.label: restaurant07_explanatory_01
entries.text: This compote is the height of decadence—a dish truly\nrefined to outstanding quality.

entries.label: restaurant07_explanatory_02
entries.text: A ratatouille made from carefully-selected ingredients,\nrefining the dish beyond measure.

entries.label: restaurant07_explanatory_03
entries.text: This quiche is made from first-rate ingredients—a dish\nthat is refined to reach the pinnacle of quiches.

entries.label: restaurant07_explanatory_04
entries.text: Cost was not considered when making this pot-au-feu,\nrefining it into the ultimate dish.

entries.label: restaurant08_explanatory_00
entries.text: This dish is notable for its poignant spiciness.\nIts reasonable price is also part of the appeal.

entries.label: restaurant08_explanatory_01
entries.text: This has enough calories to keep a person going for a day.\nIt is cost-effective for one’s stomach.

entries.label: restaurant08_explanatory_02
entries.text: The acidity is stimulating despite its artificial nature.\nThis dessert is perfect after an oily meal.

entries.label: restaurant08_explanatory_03
entries.text: The mix of greens, veggies, and salad dressing in this\ndish makes it quite popular.

entries.label: restaurant08_explanatory_04
entries.text: One can’t go wrong with this signature dish. The generous\nportions make it popular among youths.

entries.label: restaurant09_explanatory_00
entries.text: The Scovillain sauce goes perfectly with the crispy\nfried potatoes.

entries.label: restaurant09_explanatory_01
entries.text: The light, crunchy texture is very enjoyable.\nThese treats go well with slightly bitter coffee.

entries.label: restaurant09_explanatory_02
entries.text: It has freshly squeezed lemon juice and strong\ncarbonation. It’s a drink one wants to gulp down.

entries.label: restaurant09_explanatory_03
entries.text: A blend of coffee that’s slightly on the bitter end.\nIts fragrant aroma makes it easy to keep drinking.

entries.label: restaurant09_explanatory_04
entries.text: A simple dish with only cheese and ham as fillings.\nIt has a crispy texture and is easy to eat.

entries.label: restaurant10_explanatory_00
entries.text: A veggie-heavy stuffing and a piquant sauce make this\nsandwich a very refreshing meal.

entries.label: restaurant10_explanatory_01
entries.text: The thick sweetness lingers in the mouth—a treat for the\ntaste buds.

entries.label: restaurant10_explanatory_02
entries.text: The potato salad makes this sandwich nicely filling.\nThis is a perfect lunchtime meal.

entries.label: restaurant10_explanatory_03
entries.text: Pickles are the only filling in this single-minded sandwich.\nIt’s an exceedingly simple meal.

entries.label: restaurant10_explanatory_04
entries.text: The key is that the eggs aren’t scrambled—rather, they are\nthinly-sliced boiled eggs.

entries.label: restaurant11_explanatory_00
entries.text: The subtle spiciness makes the rice taste sweet. The key to\nthis dish is a light touch—it should not be dense or heavy!

entries.label: restaurant11_explanatory_01
entries.text: This dish is good for a snack or as a dessert to wrap up a\nmeal. Its gentle sweetness doesn’t overstay its welcome.

entries.label: restaurant11_explanatory_02
entries.text: This pickled plum dish is so sour it’ll numb your tongue.\nIt has a nice kick of saltiness and a hint of umami.

entries.label: restaurant11_explanatory_03
entries.text: This is a recreation of a dish that the head chef\nencountered during her travels in the Hoenn region.

entries.label: restaurant11_explanatory_04
entries.text: This dish comes with a simple garnish of green onions, so\none can enjoy the noodles and broth without distraction.

entries.label: restaurant12_explanatory_00
entries.text: The spicy flavoring is irresistible. This dish not only has a\nbite, but plenty of umami as well.

entries.label: restaurant12_explanatory_01
entries.text: This dish is good freshly made and piping hot, but it’s also\ndelicious served cold and drenched in syrup.

entries.label: restaurant12_explanatory_02
entries.text: This soup’s thickness keeps it warm longer. The sourness\nof the seasonings is delicious.

entries.label: restaurant12_explanatory_03
entries.text: With its refreshing bitterness and full-bodied aroma, this\ntea goes well with oily dishes.

entries.label: restaurant12_explanatory_04
entries.text: This soup has an exceedingly rich flavor. It is said that the\ningredients are a house secret.

entries.label: restaurant13_explanatory_00
entries.text: Standard churro. Nothing fancy, but it’s tasty all the same.

entries.label: restaurant13_explanatory_01
entries.text: A churro covered in chocolate. Nothing fancy, but it’s\ntasty all the same.

entries.label: restaurant13_explanatory_02
entries.text: This churro is covered in cinnamon. Nothing fancy, but it’s\ntasty all the same.

entries.label: restaurant14_explanatory_00
entries.text: This dish is at its absolute best when freshly made. Its rich\naroma whets the appetite.

entries.label: restaurant14_explanatory_01
entries.text: These rice balls have been grilled to perfection. The soy\nsauce-based marinade is very fragrant.

entries.label: restaurant15_explanatory_00
entries.text: Made using the Kantonian shop owner’s prized recipe,\nthis crepe is topped with strawberries and chocolate.

entries.label: restaurant15_explanatory_01
entries.text: Made using the Kantonian shop owner’s prized recipe,\nthis crepe is topped with strawberries and whipped cream.

entries.label: restaurant15_explanatory_02
entries.text: Made using the Kantonian shop owner’s prized recipe,\nthis crepe is topped with bananas and chocolate.

entries.label: restaurant16_explanatory_00
entries.text: The mint flavor is strong and the chocolate is bitter—a\ndistinct contrast that keeps you coming back for more.

entries.label: restaurant16_explanatory_01
entries.text: The texture of this icy treat is delightful—and its light\nsweetness is, too. You’ll never get tired of eating this.

entries.label: restaurant16_explanatory_02
entries.text: Fresh strawberries are folded into the ice cream, so you\ncan taste their natural sweetness.

entries.label: restaurant16_explanatory_03
entries.text: Well-ripened mangoes are carefully selected for this ice\ncream. Its stunning sweetness may not be for everyone.

entries.label: restaurant16_explanatory_04
entries.text: This is the shop’s signature ice cream, using Nacli’s salt\nfor its gentler flavor.

entries.label: restaurant16_explanatory_05
entries.text: This dish is secretly very popular, with the sweet-and-salty\nsauce bringing many repeat customers.

entries.label: restaurant20_explanatory_02
entries.text: The vibrant lemon coloring is pleasing to the eye.\nThis festival staple has no acidity.

entries.text: This shaved ice is covered in a syrup that evokes the color\nof the Alolan sea.

entries.label: restaurant20_explanatory_04

entries.text: The Maillard reaction that occurs when browning the sauce\nleads to an absolutely irresistible aroma and flavor.

entries.label: restaurant22_explanatory_00
entries.text: The apple beneath the candy coating is from the land of\nKitakami, giving this treat its great flavor.

entries.label: restaurant22_explanatory_01
entries.text: Green apples from the land of Kitakami have a strong\nacidity, which pairs perfectly with a candy coating.

entries.label: restaurant22_explanatory_02
entries.text: It tastes incredibly bitter to humans, but there’s no end to\nthe children who buy it, fooled by its appetizing look.

entries.label: restaurant22_explanatory_03
entries.text: This treat is 100 percent spicy-dry Razz Berry, causing any\nhuman who tries it to make an indescribable face.

entries.label: restaurant22_explanatory_04
entries.text: This Berry treat is easier to stomach than the others, and its\ncomplex flavor is popular among connoisseurs.

entries.label: restaurant22_explanatory_05
entries.text: The sweetness of the candy coating and the spicy-sour\ntaste of the Pinap Berry form a perfect combination.
